title: Revalidate a scoped closing owner when the held-claims page is incomplete
outcome: For a scoped ordinary close, an incomplete held-claims page does not prove the retained owner lost its claim. Preserve exact-owner and store/connection fences while resolving the omitted owner or reporting a bounded, specific refusal.
acceptance: An exact held opening owner omitted from a bounded held-claims page can be revalidated without using the cached focus as authority.
A proven lost owner is refused and an unprovable owner reaches a bounded explicit refusal. No outcome, checks or source attribution cross to a different owner.
Deterministic coverage exercises omission of the retained owner and actual loss.
